mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI increases are not followed by tighter monetary policy within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increases are not followed by broader economic slowdown indicators within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past two months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increases are not followed by positive earnings surprises within the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months signals supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases are not followed by broader supply-side disruptions within the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the past month, the combined signal of tight monetary policy and inflationary pressure leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL is not followed by negative market sentiment within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3pp and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease in the same month, the combined signal of labor market weakness leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS is not followed by negative economic indicators within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months, coupled with a rise in retail sales (RSAFS), signals strong demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase in 2 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or increases in HOUST and RSAFS are not followed by broader economic growth indicators within the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of economic expansion, a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% in the previous quarter.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 0.5% in 2 months and GDPC1 growth < 2% in previous quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of decreasing INDPRO and low GDPC1 growth is not followed by negative earnings revisions within the next quarter.
